prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1389; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you were involved in while driving in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the best number to reach you.

A: I'd rather keep my personal details off the recording for now, but I can give you a callback number through the claim file.

Q: That works. Can you walk me through what happened leading up to the collision?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road heading toward the freeway. It was a normal afternoon, traffic was moderate. The light was red and I had come to a complete stop behind a silver sedan.

Q: How long were you stopped before the impact?

A: Probably ten or fifteen seconds. Long enough that I had fully stopped and was waiting for the light.

Q: What happened next?

A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My car was pushed forward into the sedan in front of me. My head snapped back and then forward, and my right hand hit the steering wheel.

Q: Did you notice anything about the vehicle behind you before the impact?

A: I checked my mirror a moment before stopping and saw a pickup truck approaching fast. I didn't have time to react after that.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, I was taken to the emergency room that evening. They X-rayed my right wrist and told me it was fractured. I've been wearing a splint and I'm scheduled for follow-up with an orthopedic specialist.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the collision or your injuries?

A: Only that my wrist has limited my ability to work and drive comfortably. I'm willing to provide the medical records.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you about those records. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
